title: Owl reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- tree branch -->
  <rect x='5' y='80' width='90' height='8' rx='4' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <rect x='5' y='80' width='90' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#A9713A'/>
  <!-- owl body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='20' ry='22' fill='#B8860B'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='14' ry='15' fill='#D9A441'/>
  <!-- wings -->
  <ellipse cx='29' cy='58' rx='8' ry='17' fill='#8B6508'/>
  <ellipse cx='71' cy='58' rx='8' ry='17' fill='#8B6508'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='32' r='17' fill='#C99A2E'/>
  <!-- ear tufts -->
  <polygon points='36,20 33,8 43,17' fill='#A67C1A'/>
  <polygon points='64,20 67,8 57,17' fill='#A67C1A'/>
  <!-- eye discs -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='31' r='8' fill='#F2E2C0'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='31' r='8' fill='#F2E2C0'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='31' r='4' fill='#FFC33A'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='31' r='4' fill='#FFC33A'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='31' r='2' fill='#2D1B4E'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='31' r='2' fill='#2D1B4E'/>
  <!-- beak -->
  <polygon points='46,40 54,40 50,47' fill='#E8842A'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <path d='M40,79 l-4,5 M40,79 l0,6 M40,79 l4,5' stroke='#E8842A' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M60,79 l-4,5 M60,79 l0,6 M60,79 l4,5' stroke='#E8842A' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- book -->
  <polygon points='30,64 50,60 50,78 30,82' fill='#3D7EDB'/>
  <polygon points='70,64 50,60 50,78 70,82' fill='#5A9BF0'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='60' x2='50' y2='78' stroke='#2255A8' stroke-width='2'/>
  <line x1='35' y1='67' x2='46' y2='64.5' stroke='#BFD9FF' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='35' y1='72' x2='46' y2='69.5' stroke='#BFD9FF' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='35' y1='77' x2='46' y2='74.5' stroke='#BFD9FF' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='54' y1='64.5' x2='65' y2='67' stroke='#CFE5FF' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='54' y1='69.5' x2='65' y2='72' stroke='#CFE5FF' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='54' y1='74.5' x2='65' y2='77' stroke='#CFE5FF' stroke-width='1.5'/>
</svg>
